messages.subject: For Xavier Saint Martin Tillet | Uranium, stakeholder leadership and responsible mining
messages.body:
Dear Orano Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Xavier Saint Martin Tillet, Senior Executive Vice President of the Mining Business Unit.

Orano's uranium mining activities operate at the intersection of energy security, government relationships, community confidence and responsible resource development. That interface closely matches the work I lead today within a multinational mining environment.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate integrates government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead country-facing engagement with public institutions and communities, coordinate regulatory and stakeholder obligations across operating functions, and translate external commitments into accountable owners, evidence requirements and escalation paths. I also support governance around a major solar and battery-storage platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this experience might support Orano Mining's government relations, social performance, external affairs or international stakeholder priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Orano.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
